title: 第9章 值了第10章 游击弓术
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条

“嗷……”
青岚座狼摇晃着站了起来。它那双泛着绿光的眸子死死盯着维克多的方向。
虽然它已经有些看不清东西了，但它能闻到那个卑鄙偷袭者的味道。
它张开嘴，喉咙深处再次亮起了青色的微光。
“该死！还有蓝！”
维克多亡魂大冒。在开阔的河床边面对一个远程法师，简直是找死。
他手脚并用地爬起来，向着一块巨大的岩石后面冲去。
“休！休！休！”
三道风刃接连飞来。
第一道削飞了维克多的兜帽，几缕黑发在空中飘散。第二道在他大腿外侧的皮甲上划出一道深深的口子，鲜血直流。
第三道击碎了他面前的岩石，碎石飞溅，打得他脸颊生疼。
维克多狼狈地缩在半截岩石后面，大口喘息着。腿上的剧痛和死亡的阴影让他握弓的手都在微微颤抖。
“冷静！冷静！维克多！”
他强迫自己冷静下来。
“它受伤很重，那是回光返照。这种强度的连发，它撑不了多久。”
维克多听着岩石另一侧传来的沉重脚步声。那头狼在靠近。它不想放过这个打扰它休息的虫子。
不能露头。一露头就会被秒。
但也不能一直躲着，等它绕过来也是死。
维克多看了一眼周围。河床，乱石，还有……刚才被切断的那棵树。

一个疯狂的计划在脑海中成型。
他迅速从背包里掏出一块刚才没吃完的带血的兔肉，那是他原本留着的午餐。
“赌一把你的本能。”
维克多将剩下驱虫粉末倒在兔肉上，然后用尽全力，向着左侧的空地扔了出去。
“啪嗒。”
兔肉落地。
青岚座狼的脚步顿了一下。浓烈的血腥味和刺激性气味干扰了它的嗅觉判断。作为野兽，它下意识地转头看向那个落点，喉咙里的风元素本能地蓄势待发。
就在这一瞬间。
【噪点伪装，启动！】
维克多强忍着腿伤的剧痛，从岩石的右侧猛地窜出。
他没有站定瞄准，而是在移动中拉开了弓弦。
青岚座狼反应极快，它意识到自己被骗了，猛地转过头，那张血盆大口再次对准了维克多，口中的青光已经凝聚到了极致。
这是一场速度的赌博。
是维克多的箭快，还是青岚座狼的瞬发法术快。
如果是普通的箭，必死无疑。
但维克多这次搭在弦上的，不是黑铁箭，而是那支他一直舍不得用的、老约翰留下的——爆裂箭矢。
据说是从某个冒险者手上用重金换过来的。
“去！”
维克多松弦的瞬间，整个人顺势向后仰倒。
“轰——呼！”

几乎是同一时间。
座狼口中的风刃喷薄而出，擦着维克多的头皮飞过，削断了他身后的几根灌木。

"Ouch..."
Qinglan Warg stood up unsteadily. Its glowing green eyes stared in Victor's direction.
Although it could no longer see clearly, it could smell the scent of the despicable attacker.
It opened its mouth, and the cyan light lit up deep in its throat again.
"Damn! And blue!"
The ghost of Victor emerges. Facing a long-range mage by the open riverbed is simply asking for death.
He climbed up on his hands and knees and rushed behind a huge rock.
"Hugh! Hugh! Hugh!"
Three wind blades flew in succession.
The first one sliced ​​off Victor's hood, and a few strands of black hair were scattered in the air. The second cut made a deep gash in the leather armor on the outside of his thigh, and blood flowed freely.
The third one shattered the rock in front of him, sending gravel flying and hurting his cheek.
Victor huddled in embarrassment behind half of the rock, breathing heavily. The severe pain in his legs and the shadow of death made his hand holding the bow tremble slightly.
"Calm down! Calm down! Victor!"
He forced himself to calm down.
"It was seriously injured. It was a flashback. It couldn't last long with a series of attacks of this intensity."
Victor listened to the heavy footsteps coming from the other side of the rock. The wolf is approaching. It didn't want to let go of the bug that disturbed its rest.
The head cannot be exposed. As soon as you show your head, you will be killed.
But you can't hide all the time. Waiting for it to come around will also lead to death.
Victor glanced around. The river bed, the rocks, and... the tree that was cut off just now.
A crazy plan formed in his mind.
He quickly took out a piece of bloody rabbit meat from his backpack that he had not finished eating just now. It was the lunch he had saved.
"Bet on your instincts."
Victor poured the remaining deworming powder on the rabbit meat, and then threw it towards the open space on the left with all his strength.
"Crack."
Rabbit meat fell to the ground.
Qinglan Warg paused for a moment. The strong smell of blood and pungent smell interfered with its sense of smell. As a beast, it subconsciously turned its head to look at the landing point, and the wind element in its throat instinctively prepared to attack.
Just at this moment.
[Noise camouflage, start! 】
Victor endured the severe pain of his leg injury and jumped out from the right side of the rock.
He did not stand still and take aim, but drew the bow string while moving.
The Qinglan warg reacted very quickly. It realized that it had been deceived, and turned its head suddenly. The bloody mouth was aimed at Victor again, and the green light in the mouth had been condensed to the extreme.
It's a gamble on speed.
Is it Victor's arrows that are faster, or Qinglan Warg's instant spells that are faster?
If it were an ordinary arrow, death would be certain.
But what Victor put on the string this time was not the black iron arrow, but the explosive arrow left by Old John that he had been reluctant to use.
It is said that it was obtained from an adventurer in exchange for a lot of money.
"Go!"
The moment Victor let go of the string, his whole body fell backwards.
"Boom-hoo!"
Almost at the same time.
The wind blade from the warg's mouth spurted out and flew past Victor's scalp, cutting off several bushes behind him.
